title: Continuing transmission beyond a fixed reward

captions.physics: Explaining and continuing consciously chosen knowledge

meaning: Taking part in change can inspire you when passing knowledge on brings freedom from needing familiar confirmation of your role.
text: What you pass on can continue differently from what you expected. The Wheel of Fortune in the energy of Sahasrara supports readiness to join life’s changing movement. The Hierophant in the physical position describes shared actions: learning within a chosen tradition, explaining foundations and sharing experience. The Devil in emotions brings a liberating recognition of attachment. Noticing an expectation of recognition can feel freeing when it need not govern participation. Shared meaning becomes available to others and retains its value even when their continuation does not return to you through familiar thanks or constant mentions.

For example, you demonstrate a paper-working technique together at an open gathering. Later, a participant uses it in an independent session, explaining things in their own way. **Transmission remains meaningful when its continuation need not confirm your role.** A pleasant sense of space appears: usefulness has genuinely travelled further. Your work has entered someone else’s interest, and preserved foundations now meet new people through the voice of someone who once arrived to try and ask their first questions.

The difficulty may arise if teaching requires an explanation to be reproduced word for word. A new guide understands the foundation but doubts whether speaking differently is allowed. An open motive and a feeling of freedom remain supportive. Action benefits from distinguishing accurate content from ownership of wording, continuing substance through another person’s words without holding every gathering within your initial script.
